sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Many parents carry myths about DFV that make it harder to recognise abuse or seek help.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Myths include 'DFV is caused by anger' or 'If it was really bad, they would leave'. These are false and harmful.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn to replace myths with accurate, evidenceâ€‘based understanding.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Identify a myth you once believed. What changed your understanding?

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Letting go of myths helps parents see their situation clearly and make informed decisions.
